notes.title: GodsTV trailer out now, Kickstarter live July 8
notes.content:
[h1][b]It’s Fame Time! [/b][/h1][p]We aired today a brand-new trailer for [i][b]GodsTV[/b][/i], the hottest Fame Show Arena Roguelike on galactic TV. 

This cartoony kill-fest for consenting adults is a madcap, irreverent parody of fame and violence. [i]GodsTV[/i] turns every weapon, power-up and skill into product placement for the Sponsor-Gods.

[i]“Because you’re no longer just a fighter, you’re a star.” [/i][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="_DN8DiGfoFk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Hit “Notify me” on Kickstarter[/h2][p]The clip also fires the starting pistol for the game’s [b]Demo launch and[/b] [b]Kickstarter campaign, coming out on July 8th 2025[/b].  Early-bird backers will bag exclusive vanity gear, beta access and a first crack at the game’s most coveted God’s Gifts. 
[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621752/32fbb0ca0e4c5c35c4c8e5c713943fe246720a19.png"][/img][/p]
